result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken image placeholder in Popular right now, truncated restaurant names, and a sparse card layout that looks incomplete.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows only a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback thumbnail so the card does not appear empty or broken.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with the rest cut off.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure horizontal cards give enough width for full names.

issues.description: The Popular right now card is mostly empty gray space with a small €0 delivery badge and heart icon, making the layout look sparse and unfinished above the title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the hero image fills the card area consistently with other restaurant cards, or tighten spacing if no image is available.
